title: Recruiter CV Attachment
scenario: A recruiter sends an unsolicited CV file with macros enabled.

answers.A: Use the approved company system or verified process.
answers.B: Act immediately because the request sounds urgent and important.
answers.C: Escalate to IT, finance, HR, legal, or your manager through official channels.
answers.D: Reply to the sender asking them to confirm the request.

explanation: Recruiter CV Attachment: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Unexpected attachments should be scanned or handled by secure process.
